headline: GK Capital Arranges J$1.5 Billion Bond for PriceSmart Jamaica Expansion
summary: GK Capital Management underwrote a J$1.5 billion five-year corporate bond to finance PriceSmart's expansion in Jamaica, funding the construction of two new warehouse retail clubs.
why: PriceSmart is a US-headquartered membership warehouse club operator focused on Latin America and the Caribbean.

impacts.name: PriceSmart
impacts.why: J$1.5 billion bond financing supports PriceSmart's retail footprint doubling in Jamaica.
